$comment: Spend caps are off by default (null = no limit), by the owner's choice. The owner can set one in Settings. Concurrency ceilings stay: they protect AgentCore quotas, not spend. max_workers_per_goal is a hard cap on the live workers one manager may have on one goal at a time (the owner's choice after a 50-sentence request hired 21 workers); hire_worker refuses above it.
